purpose: Determine, under a bounded and reproducible search, whether an explicit non-equilibrium algebraic witness exists on the planar Newtonian three-body common level (H,C)=(0,0) that is suitable for Morales-Ramis or Ziglin analysis.
claim_boundary: A QUALIFIED_WITNESS result certifies only that one explicit phase curve satisfies every locked witness-suitability requirement. It is not a differential-Galois obstruction and is not a nonintegrability theorem. A COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT certifies only that the declared search protocol found no qualifying witness; it is not a proof that no witness exists.

target_model.system: Full planar Newtonian three-body problem with finite positive masses, after center-of-mass reduction and in the algebraic-distance complexification used by WP6-COMMON-v1.
target_model.desired_mass_scope: Arbitrary finite positive mass triples, either through one parametric witness family or a finite exhaustive mass-branch cover.
target_model.desired_method: Morales-Ramis or Ziglin analysis of the variational equations tangent to M_(0,0).
excluded_substitutes: charged, relativistic, post-Newtonian, or otherwise modified potentials
numerical trajectories without exact phase-curve equations
asymptotic solutions without an exact orbit
special-mass-only witnesses without an exhaustive mass branch
equilibria and the already-known homothetic central-configuration curve

preexisting_qualified_facts.common_level_gap: WP6-COMMON-v1 qualifies restricted rational nonintegrability for every finite real (h,c)!=(0,0) and expressly excludes (0,0).
preexisting_qualified_facts.homothetic_failure: The pinned Combot analysis states that at H=C=0 the known homothetic variational equations are integrable at all orders and that a new explicit particular orbit is required.
preexisting_qualified_facts.fi1_boundary: WP6-FI1-v1 excludes one additional ambient meromorphic integral but cannot be transferred automatically to a function defined only on M_(0,0).
preexisting_qualified_facts.so3_boundary: The regular noncollinear SO(3) chart does not contain a collinear witness.

witness_requirements.W1: The candidate solves the full planar Newtonian three-body equations exactly on a nonempty open part of its phase curve.
witness_requirements.W2: The candidate is valid for arbitrary finite positive masses or belongs to a finite set of branches proved exhaustive over that mass domain.
witness_requirements.W3: The candidate is nonstationary and is not merely the known homothetic central-configuration solution.
witness_requirements.W4: The candidate satisfies H=0 and C=0 identically by exact symbolic calculation.
witness_requirements.W5: The orbit is an algebraic phase curve over an explicitly declared differential base field.
witness_requirements.W6: The algebraic-distance variables and every denominator are valid on a nonempty dense open subset of the phase curve.
witness_requirements.W7: The gradients of H and C are independent at a generic point of the candidate, so the tangent common-level variational equation is well-defined.
witness_requirements.W8: An exact tangent VE can be derived and the flow, classical-integral, symmetry, and gauge directions can be separated.
witness_requirements.W9: At least one nontrivial NVE block has rational or algebraic coefficients over the declared base field and is not merely the known obstruction-free homothetic equation.
witness_requirements.W10: The candidate avoids collision singularities on the analyzed open curve, or an exact meromorphic regularization and pullback to the physical common level are proved.
witness_requirements.W11: A source-disjoint exact implementation reproduces the orbit equations, H=C=0, generic regularity, and NVE coefficient data.
witness_requirements.W12: Every source payload and derivation input has immutable provenance, and no production implementation is imported by the independent reference.

mandatory_candidate_classes: triple-collision, McGehee, and regularized collision solutions
published algebraic or meromorphic particular solutions
published zero-level Morales-Ramis or Ziglin analyses

required_outputs.search_receipt: Every locked query, result page, inspected primary source, citation expansion, and exclusion reason.
required_outputs.source_manifest: Immutable metadata and SHA-256 for every primary payload used in a decision.
required_outputs.candidate_ledger: One record per distinct candidate family with W1-W12 decisions and exact failure reasons.
required_outputs.exact_audit: Project-owned symbolic checks for every candidate reaching W4.
required_outputs.independent_reference: Source-disjoint exact reproduction for any candidate that reaches W8.
required_outputs.final_record: A signed QUALIFIED_WITNESS, COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT, or INCOMPLETE decision.

adversarial_controls: Reject the legacy equal-mass Euler fixture as H=0 when its stated positions and velocities give exact H=-1.
Reject the corrected H=C=0 Euler collapse as a qualifying witness because it is the known homothetic curve.
Reject Newtonian scaling as a way to change a nonzero energy orbit into zero energy because scaling preserves the sign of H.
Reject a numerical residual or high-precision trajectory as an algebraic phase curve.
Reject a restricted, charged, relativistic, or otherwise modified three-body system.
Reject a special-mass-only candidate as satisfying arbitrary-positive-mass scope.
Reject a collision orbit without a proved meromorphic regularization and exact model connection.
Reject an orbit if H=0 or C=0 holds only at one initial point rather than identically.
Reject a candidate whose tangent NVE cannot be defined on a generically smooth common level.
Reject opening WP6-DZ-MR-v1 from PARTIAL_CANDIDATE or COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT.

decision_policy.QUALIFIED_WITNESS: At least one candidate passes W1 through W12, the search record is complete through the success point, and all adversarial controls pass.
decision_policy.COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT: Every locked search query and mandatory candidate class is complete, every plausible candidate has a W1-W12 ledger, no candidate passes all requirements, all exact negative controls pass, and the source budget or query frontier is exhausted.
decision_policy.INCOMPLETE: Any locked query, mandatory class, source record, candidate audit, prerequisite, control, or integrity gate is missing or changed.
decision_policy.MR_PROMOTION_RULE: Create WP6-DZ-MR-v1 only when the signed feasibility record status is QUALIFIED_WITNESS and names exactly one frozen witness payload. Every other status prohibits promotion.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_NULL_CLAIM: Under the locked WP6-DZ-FEAS-v1 primary-source and exact-audit protocol, no explicit non-equilibrium algebraic phase curve satisfying every W1-W12 requirement was found.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_NONINTEGRABILITY_CLAIM: The planar Newtonian three-body problem is nonintegrable on (H,C)=(0,0).
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_MR_CLAIM: A differential-Galois or Ziglin obstruction has been proved.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_SPECIAL_MASS_PROMOTION: A special-mass-only candidate closes the arbitrary-positive-mass gap.

stop_rule.success_stop: Stop the feasibility search after one candidate passes W1-W12 and its exact independent reproduction is frozen.
stop_rule.null_stop: Return COMPLETE_BOUNDED_NULL_RESULT only after every locked query and mandatory class is complete, all plausible candidates are audited, citation expansion is exhausted, and no candidate passes W1-W12.
stop_rule.no_scope_extension: Do not add candidate classes, relax W1-W12, raise a cap, or reinterpret a partial candidate after seeing search outcomes; such a change requires WP6-DZ-FEAS-v2.

invalidation: Any changed target model, prerequisite, query protocol, candidate class, witness requirement, source cap, stop rule, adversarial control, decision rule, or promotion rule invalidates v1.
